protocol.a4_rule: if synchronization disagreement exceeds pilot median, use A0; otherwise use A1
protocol.a5_lift_policy: exclude: no certified natural-MNIST lift in current claim ledger
protocol.selection_tie_break: validation accuracy descending, validation loss ascending, stable candidate name
protocol.test_policy: freeze A0-A5/B0 choices before first test evaluation; A6 only is test-selected

threshold_source: median synchronization disagreement across pilot settings; no test metric used
